title: Delulu Stream Real-Time Video Manipulation
summary: A real-time AI transformation layer for streamers that swaps appearance, outfits, and backgrounds instantly. It integrates with OBS and allows viewers to trigger live changes through interactive chat commands.
research_notes: Developed by Decart.AI. Known for its 'Identity Layer' concept where streamers can morph based on viewer engagement or personal presets in real-time.

evolution.summary: Evolved from a mobile photo remixing app into a sophisticated identity layer for live broadcasting. Recently added a cloud-powered desktop client to reduce local hardware load and expanded interactive Twitch/Kick integrations.
